cases.sql: CREATE SCHEMA node_bounds
SET search_path=node_bounds,public
CREATE TABLE ri(n integer) PARTITION BY RANGE(n)
CREATE TABLE ri_neg PARTITION OF ri FOR VALUES FROM (-10) TO (0)
CREATE TABLE ri_mid PARTITION OF ri FOR VALUES FROM (0) TO (10)
CREATE TABLE ri_low PARTITION OF ri FOR VALUES FROM (MINVALUE) TO (-10)
CREATE TABLE ri_high PARTITION OF ri FOR VALUES FROM (10) TO (MAXVALUE)
CREATE TABLE ri_default PARTITION OF ri DEFAULT
CREATE TABLE rt(n integer,t text) PARTITION BY RANGE(n,t)
CREATE TABLE rt_pair PARTITION OF rt FOR VALUES FROM (0,MINVALUE) TO (10,MAXVALUE)
CREATE TABLE lt(t text) PARTITION BY LIST(t)
CREATE TABLE lt_values PARTITION OF lt FOR VALUES IN ('a', 'O''Reilly', E'back\\slash', NULL)
CREATE TABLE lb(b boolean) PARTITION BY LIST(b)
CREATE TABLE lb_values PARTITION OF lb FOR VALUES IN (true,false,NULL)
CREATE TABLE rn(n numeric) PARTITION BY RANGE(n)
CREATE TABLE rn_values PARTITION OF rn FOR VALUES FROM (-1.25) TO ('Infinity')
CREATE TABLE rd(d date) PARTITION BY RANGE(d)
CREATE TABLE rd_values PARTITION OF rd FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2025-01-01')
CREATE TABLE ra(a integer[]) PARTITION BY RANGE(a)
CREATE TABLE ra_values PARTITION OF ra FOR VALUES FROM (ARRAY[1,2]) TO (ARRAY[3,4])
CREATE TABLE hh(n integer) PARTITION BY HASH(n)
CREATE TABLE hh_part PARTITION OF hh FOR VALUES WITH (MODULUS 4, REMAINDER 3)

SELECT relname,relpartbound::text,pg_get_expr(relpartbound,0,false),pg_get_expr(relpartbound,0,true),pg_get_expr(relpartbound,oid) FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='node_bounds'::regnamespace AND relispartition ORDER BY relname
